ftd.rule: PREGAME-2026-09-29: one man a slate, placed before kickoff (books assumed not to take first-TD bets after the toss); P = market anytime split x usage/home/favourite tilt, averaged over the two toss outcomes; best EV at +300..+1000, no QB
ftd.price_curve: FTD implied = split x (0.997 - 0.063 ln split), from the PIT@CLE first-TD board
